findings.title: Approved role and rollback requests do not apply canonical authorization

observation.actualBehavior: Approval status changes without an Identity or Workforce role mutation.
observation.expectedBehavior: An approved decision must apply the canonical assignment or remain unapproved.

evidence.resultSummary: Approval status changes without an Identity or Workforce role mutation.

rootCause.immediateCause: Approval status changes without an Identity or Workforce role mutation.
rootCause.structuralCause: DSH approval status is decoupled from the authority-owning mutation.

resolution.strategy: An approved decision must apply the canonical assignment or remain unapproved.

criteria.statement: An approved decision must apply the canonical assignment or remain unapproved.

findings.title: DSH creates a parallel role-definition authority

observation.actualBehavior: Approved requests insert active roles into dsh_admin_roles.
observation.expectedBehavior: Identity must be the sole durable owner of role and permission definitions.

evidence.resultSummary: Approved requests insert active roles into dsh_admin_roles.

rootCause.immediateCause: Approved requests insert active roles into dsh_admin_roles.
rootCause.structuralCause: The DSH facade writes authorization truth locally instead of delegating to Identity.

resolution.strategy: Identity must be the sole durable owner of role and permission definitions.

criteria.statement: Identity must be the sole durable owner of role and permission definitions.

findings.title: Administration routes expose synthetic and contract-incompatible behavior

observation.actualBehavior: Staff listing is always empty, diagnostics are hardcoded healthy, creates return 200, and errors collapse to generic 500.
observation.expectedBehavior: Handlers must return measured data, contract status codes, stable conflicts, and sanitized errors.

evidence.resultSummary: Staff listing is always empty, diagnostics are hardcoded healthy, creates return 200, and errors collapse to generic 500.

rootCause.immediateCause: Staff listing is always empty, diagnostics are hardcoded healthy, creates return 200, and errors collapse to generic 500.
rootCause.structuralCause: Route wiring was added without contract-to-handler conformance and measured projections.

resolution.strategy: Handlers must return measured data, contract status codes, stable conflicts, and sanitized errors.

criteria.statement: Handlers must return measured data, contract status codes, stable conflicts, and sanitized errors.

findings.title: The DSH contract registry is outside mandatory typecheck and contains an invalid strategy

observation.actualBehavior: The registry uses BOUNDED_CONTEXT_GENERATED although the strategy type does not permit it, and service typecheck excludes the registry.
observation.expectedBehavior: Every active registry entry and service truth file must compile under the mandatory DSH check.

evidence.resultSummary: The registry uses BOUNDED_CONTEXT_GENERATED although the strategy type does not permit it, and service typecheck excludes the registry.

rootCause.immediateCause: The registry uses BOUNDED_CONTEXT_GENERATED although the strategy type does not permit it, and service typecheck excludes the registry.
rootCause.structuralCause: The TypeScript project boundary covers consumers but omits contract and readiness authority files.

resolution.strategy: Every active registry entry and service truth file must compile under the mandatory DSH check.

criteria.statement: Every active registry entry and service truth file must compile under the mandatory DSH check.

findings.title: DSH readiness sources contradict each other and lack same-commit evidence

observation.actualBehavior: The manifest marks backend and database ready while runtime-map marks all capability database and client readiness false with null evidence SHA.
observation.expectedBehavior: All readiness projections must derive from one evidence ledger bound to the verified commit.

evidence.resultSummary: The manifest marks backend and database ready while runtime-map marks all capability database and client readiness false with null evidence SHA.

rootCause.immediateCause: The manifest marks backend and database ready while runtime-map marks all capability database and client readiness false with null evidence SHA.
rootCause.structuralCause: Independent hardcoded readiness projections have no enforced consistency gate.

resolution.strategy: All readiness projections must derive from one evidence ledger bound to the verified commit.

criteria.statement: All readiness projections must derive from one evidence ledger bound to the verified commit.

findings.title: Active DSH contract shards lack complete generated-client ownership proof

observation.actualBehavior: Many active shards rely on manual typed adapters and the manifest says shard and CI subset verification remains required.
observation.expectedBehavior: Every operation must have one validated client strategy, owner, consumer path, and route parity proof.

evidence.resultSummary: Many active shards rely on manual typed adapters and the manifest says shard and CI subset verification remains required.

rootCause.immediateCause: Many active shards rely on manual typed adapters and the manifest says shard and CI subset verification remains required.
rootCause.structuralCause: Contract registration does not itself prove generated coverage or adapter conformance.
rootCause.incorrectOrMissingTruthOwner: DSH contract registry and generated clients

truthOwnership.correctOwner: DSH contract registry and generated clients

resolution.strategy: Every operation must have one validated client strategy, owner, consumer path, and route parity proof.

criteria.statement: Every operation must have one validated client strategy, owner, consumer path, and route parity proof.

findings.title: WLT persistence, generated clients, mutation, reconciliation, and journey evidence remain incomplete

observation.actualBehavior: The WLT manifest records database and generated client false, null evidence SHA, and all mutation and journey verification false.
observation.expectedBehavior: Financial readiness must stay fail-closed until migration, clients, mutation, reconciliation, isolation, and journey checks pass on one commit.

evidence.resultSummary: The WLT manifest records database and generated client false, null evidence SHA, and all mutation and journey verification false.

rootCause.immediateCause: The WLT manifest records database and generated client false, null evidence SHA, and all mutation and journey verification false.
rootCause.structuralCause: Implementation existence is not connected to a complete financial evidence gate.

resolution.strategy: Financial readiness must stay fail-closed until migration, clients, mutation, reconciliation, isolation, and journey checks pass on one commit.

criteria.statement: Financial readiness must stay fail-closed until migration, clients, mutation, reconciliation, isolation, and journey checks pass on one commit.

findings.title: Runtime aliases can collect evidence from a partial dependency stack

observation.actualBehavior: runtime:all starts only DSH and media while runtime:full includes Identity, Workforce, DSH, WLT, simulators, mail, and media.
observation.expectedBehavior: Evidence commands must name and assert the full dependency profile required by the target journey.

evidence.resultSummary: runtime:all starts only DSH and media while runtime:full includes Identity, Workforce, DSH, WLT, simulators, mail, and media.

rootCause.immediateCause: runtime:all starts only DSH and media while runtime:full includes Identity, Workforce, DSH, WLT, simulators, mail, and media.
rootCause.structuralCause: Legacy alias names no longer encode actual runtime scope.

resolution.strategy: Evidence commands must name and assert the full dependency profile required by the target journey.

criteria.statement: Evidence commands must name and assert the full dependency profile required by the target journey.

findings.title: The canonical operational journey ledger remains open and unassessed

observation.actualBehavior: The registry requires 107 journeys and 24 slices while J001 and J107 remain NOT_ASSESSED and OPEN.
observation.expectedBehavior: FOUNDATION-00 and every dependency-ready journey must close sequentially with manual, runtime, and same-commit evidence.

evidence.resultSummary: The registry requires 107 journeys and 24 slices while J001 and J107 remain NOT_ASSESSED and OPEN.

rootCause.immediateCause: The registry requires 107 journeys and 24 slices while J001 and J107 remain NOT_ASSESSED and OPEN.
rootCause.structuralCause: Repository changes are not reconciled into the canonical journey evidence ledger.

resolution.strategy: FOUNDATION-00 and every dependency-ready journey must close sequentially with manual, runtime, and same-commit evidence.

criteria.statement: FOUNDATION-00 and every dependency-ready journey must close sequentially with manual, runtime, and same-commit evidence.
